nonnested_limit_proof.argument: An L2 weak limit retains every stabilized-cell polynomial and each of its finite coefficient trace matches. For recovery keep the limit velocity outside the depth-m reserve union Dm and replace each terminal hole by the actual nodal boundary interpolant minus (20/9)*b times its cell mean. The boundary trace is unchanged, every cell mean is zero, and exact local mass extraction gives total squared replacement cost at most C_N times the original L2 mass on Dm. Absolute continuity of the integral and |Dm| tending to zero prove strong recovery without nestedness.

For a limit H1 pressure, fixed edge trace Gram bounds control all seven boundary values modulo the hole mean by its gradient energy. A fixed terminal extension has a finite operator norm, so pressure replacement error is at most C_N times the gradient integral on Dm, with an extra bounded radius-squared factor for its L2 part. Hence recovery is strong in H1. Weak restriction retains the cellwise affine constraints and fixed trace; mean correction restores the gauge. Therefore both full and zero-trace pressure-gradient subspaces Mosco-converge in L2.

For fixed trace and moment functional, choose one ambient Riesz vector F. A recovered velocity wm has residual P_Gm(wm-F) tending strongly to zero because the gradient projectors converge strongly; no assertion that the limit velocity satisfies all finite-m tests is needed. Solve the scalar discrete Neumann problem for chi and subtract beta_K*grad chi on each cell, where beta=(20/9)b. This is an actual zero-trace MINI field and changes every gradient moment by exactly the residual. Its squared L2 norm is (10/7) times the squared residual norm. The corrected recovery is strongly convergent and exactly feasible.

The strictly convex mass minimum on the convergent affine constraint sets converges strongly, by weak lower semicontinuity plus the strong recovery limsup and the quadratic norm identity. Bubble testing gives grad phi_m=T_m(f-W_m), with operator norm of T_m at most sqrt(10/7). Since T_m stabilizes outside Dm, it converges strongly on each fixed L2 vector. Consequently pressure gradients converge strongly as well; Poincare supplies H1 convergence after gauge fixing. Fixed dual ports use simultaneous pressure/neutral velocity lifts and the same kernel projection, so their complete responses also converge.

Each boundary reaction pairs the convergent response and gradient with a strongly recovered fixed-trace test. There are finitely many ports, so every DtN matrix entry, and hence its matrix norm, converges. In the proposed limiting retained-interface kernel, glued responses satisfy the full mixed equations, not merely zero-interface test equations: zero retained reactions supply the missing finite interface lifts. Testing by the glued velocity W and pressure p gives W=0; cell bubbles then give grad p=0, and the fixed gauge makes p=0. The finite square interface block is invertible, so its inverses and Schur complements converge. Passing the exact finite recursion to this limit proves the autonomous fixed point.

The adjoint visibility loads also fit this actual convergence. Root evaluation is an L2 coefficient functional on a fixed stabilized root cell, hence has a fixed L2 representer for the already fixed template. The average contrast pressure functional can explicitly be represented by F_G=t/(2|K-|) on K- and t/(2|K+|) on K+, zero elsewhere: pairing with grad q is the average of the two coarse tangential slopes, exactly [q(c+)-q(c-)]/(8r). These fixed loads and the fixed lower triangles add no new limit hypothesis. Their operator constants may depend on the fixed template; the quantitative source mismatch below separately controls the needed N dependence.

visibility_independent_calculation.argument: The six fixed compact curl actuators pair with the two coarse bubble vectors and the two root curl equations. If all six pairings vanish, c-=c+=0 and nonparallel grad(lambda_o) on the two triangles force the common root vector a=0. The six-by-six map on (a,c-,c+) is invertible. Every full velocity test restricted to the coarse cells has precisely these six coordinates. Therefore a fixed smooth solenoidal combination realizes each of the four desired full mass loads (b_K e_i,v) against EVERY actual velocity test. This proves R_h u_j=w_j for all depths. It is not the weaker bubble-only forcing assertion.

For primal v,phi and adjoint w,p, testing primal momentum by w gives (u,w)=(v,w)+(grad phi,w). Adjoint momentum tested by v gives (v,w)=v(o)_t because v annihilates grad p. Adjoint moments give (grad phi,w)=[phi(c+)-phi(c-)]/(8r). Thus reciprocity has exactly the PLUS average contrast sign. Full mass realization also gives (u_j,w)=(w_j,w), for finite or stabilized limiting coarse fields.

Put e=max |(b_K e_i,w)|. Bubble momentum has no root-evaluation right side, so grad p=O(e) on each fixed coarse cell. Exact moments give (3/20)a+(81/280)c=O(e), hence c=-(14/27)a+O(e). The mean is a/3+(9/20)c=a/10+O(e). The bottom pressure hat has gradient (0,-1/(4r)) on both triangles and zero contrast, implying a_n=O(e). Gauging p(o)=0 then gives O(e) base pressure values. All these constants concern only fixed coarse triangles.

The root-only reference response on the upper rectangle is the mass minimizer with prescribed base velocity and zero base pressure. Its mean-neutral root lift has squared mass O(a_ap*r^2*|a_t|^2) from the sharp star, and zero pressure moments. Its mass is therefore at most C*r*sqrt(a_ap)*|a_t|. The actual perturbation has O(e) normal root trace and O(e) prescribed base pressure; the neutral lift and actual logarithmic seven-node pressure extension give L2 cost at most C*K_log*e. Free side/top pressure coefficients remain outputs. No pressure nodal estimate on arbitrary H1 functions is used.

The GLOBAL root test z0=(lambda_o-(20/27)b)t has zero vector mean on every incident cell, so its pressure term vanishes exactly and (w,z0)=1. On each lower cell, replacing its bubble term costs O(e), and (w,lambda_o t)=|K|*(1/6-(14/27)*(3/20))*a_t+O(e)=(4/45)|K|*a_t+O(e). The two cell areas sum to 16r^2, so C0=64r^2/45. Above the base both the root-test norm and the reference mass contain sqrt(a_ap), giving the stated O(a_ap*|a_t|+K_log*e) error.

The GLOBAL affine pressure q=x is a valid pressure test modulo its mean on every depth. Its adjoint moment is one, so integral_D w_t=1. The two lower means give coefficient M0=(16r^2)/10=8r^2/5. The upper contribution is bounded by C*(sqrt(a_ap)*|a_t|+K_log*e). Consequently C0*a_t=1+small and M0*a_t=1+small are incompatible as e tends to zero because M0/C0=9/8. Absorbing sufficiently small aperture terms yields e>=c/K_log, hence the weaker c/(1+K_log)^2 used by the final parameter argument.

The complete mesh and coarse bubble span are reflection invariant. Orthogonal odd projection leaves the odd average functional unchanged and does not increase the mass norm. Thus one odd projected coarse source has normalized selector ell=g*L_avg at least c*sqrt(a)/(1+K_log)^2. If the independently required all-state blocks hold, the exact left eigenfunctional differs from ell by at most C*e1, not C*e2. The source state norms are uniformly bounded by the fixed coarse-source mass norms. Here e1/sqrt(a)=O(L^-15+L^-5), whereas K_log^2=O(1+log L). Hence left-eigenfunctional error is strictly smaller than the source signal for sufficiently large fixed N. This proves genuine nonzero spectral excitation, conditional on those exact blocks, without a cyclicity assumption.

fractional_divergence_independent_calcul.argument: For the actual source-free state on any child, bubble testing gives grad phi=-mean(l)-gamma*c with gamma=10/7. The pressure-selected background b_C=-mean_C grad phi obeys mean_C z-b_C=-(gamma-1)mean_C c. On each shape-regular simplex the bubble-coefficient functional vanishes on constants and is bounded by the physical fractional seminorm on P1 plus bubble modulo constants. Affine scaling gives h_K^(-2s)|K||c_K|^2<=C*[z]_{s,K}^2. Since h_K<=C*r_child and local pair integrals are disjoint subsets of the full child pair integral, ||c||<=C_N*r_child^s*[z]_{s,child}. Fractional Poincare on the rectangle and the background identity then give quotient L2 energy at most C_N*r_child^s*[z]_{s,child}.

This detection applies DIRECTLY to the infinite-depth response, rather than by an invalid upper-seminorm passage. Every stabilized-cell bubble test remains an admissible limit test, so the same coefficient identity holds. Summing its nonnegative local seminorm integrals over the countably many stabilized cells is bounded by the physical child double integral. If that integral is infinite the bound is automatic; if finite, the same coefficient and fractional-Poincare argument proves it. No global H1 regularity of the infinite velocity is assumed.

At depth m the equal-weight average of all B^m reference states is U^m s, since every child uses the actual same limiting DtN fixed point and the stated similarity/frame transport. Expanding the finite product of the mean maps proves this even though individual recovery matrices need not commute. Norm-squared convexity on the quotient gives sum_child E_ref^2>=B^m*||U^m s||^2. A nonzero left eigenfunctional gives ||U^m s||>=c*|lambda|^m with |lambda|>=1/34, conditional on the independently proved transfer blocks.

In two spatial dimensions physical L2 energy scales by r_m, so E_ref=E_phys/r_m. Physical Slobodeckij seminorm scales by r_m^(1-s), so detection is E_ref<=C_N*r_m^(s-1)*[W]_{s,child}. Hence sum_child [W]_{s,child}^2>=c_N*r_m^(2-2s)*B^m*|lambda|^(2m). Different children of one generation are disjoint, so these child pair integrals are bounded by the whole-container double integral. No summation across nested generations is used.

For s=1/8, the multiplicative factor is B*rho^(7/4)*|lambda|^2. With ell~b0*a/N, rho~sigma*ell, B~N^2/(b0*a), this is bounded below by a fixed positive multiple of N^(1/4)*sigma^(7/4)*(b0*a)^(3/4)*|lambda|^2. The given log powers yield N^(1/4)*(log N)^(-885/2)*|lambda|^2, which tends to infinity. Thus N may be fixed sufficiently large so this factor exceeds one, alongside the earlier inverse-logarithmic visibility requirements. The later h reduction does not change B,rho or the log scales.

The resulting infinite-depth restricted response has infinite physical H^(1/8) seminorm because the preceding lower bound grows for every generation. Global finite-depth mass responses converge strongly in L2; restricting to C preserves this. If a subsequence had bounded fractional seminorm, strong L2 convergence would yield an almost-everywhere convergent further subsequence. Fatou on C times C would give finite limiting seminorm, a contradiction. Therefore the finite-depth seminorms are unbounded (indeed their liminf is infinite). Terminal leaves do not need the recurrent detection estimate: the argument is made on the actual infinite limit and transferred by lower semicontinuity.

The odd source used above is a fixed finite combination of the four original smooth actuators, including their reflected partners inside the same span. If every individual source limit had finite physical fractional seminorm, their finite linear combination would as well. Hence at least one individual original smooth source gives the required rough limit and unbounded finite-depth norms. Source selection is made after the finite template is fixed, not anew at each recursion generation.
